BILLING.description: Charges, invoices, refunds, renewals and plan changes.
do_not_mark: a request for a paid add-on that doesn't exist yet, which is a feature request

examples.text: Our Meridian Cloud renewal came to $3,600 on August 14, which is more than the quote we agreed with sales.
examples.label: BILLING

BUG_REPORT.description: Something is broken for one feature, user or workflow, while the rest of the product works.
do_not_mark: failures affecting everyone or a whole office, which are outages
sign-in or credential failures, which are account access

examples.text: We are seeing E1004 on every attempt to use webhooks. This is Meridian Cloud v4.0.2 on Windows.
examples.label: BUG_REPORT

HOW_TO.description: A question about how to use or configure something that already exists.
do_not_mark: asking for something the product can't do yet, which is a feature request

examples.text: Is there a way to connect Meridian API to HubSpot so records sync automatically?
examples.label: HOW_TO

FEATURE_REQUEST.description: A request for new functionality or a change to how a feature works.

examples.text: Feature request: allow webhooks to be scoped per workspace in Meridian Cloud v4.0.2.
examples.label: FEATURE_REQUEST

OUTAGE.description: A product, feature or integration is down for all users, a whole office or the whole workspace.
do_not_mark: a failure one team or one workflow hits, which is a bug report

examples.text: Complete outage on Meridian Cloud 2026.7 for our London office. Everything returns ERR-4032.
examples.label: OUTAGE

ACCOUNT_ACCESS.description: Signing in, SSO, credentials, invitations and lockouts.

examples.text: SSO login rejects our Google Workspace credentials with AUTH-1180 since May 22.
examples.label: ACCOUNT_ACCESS
